title: apply_custom_bindings returns silently when the keymap is borrowed, but the caller still records Keymap::Applied(account)
trigger: An account's keybindings are applied (notifications/mod.rs apply_pending_keybindings) while the GPUI keymap RefCell is borrowed; try_borrow fails and the function returns without installing anything
effect: Keymap says it carries the account's overrides, so apply_pending_keybindings never retries; the account's custom chords (or the previous account's chords remain) until the next rebind or account change
fix: apply_custom_bindings returns bool/Result; caller sets Keymap::Applied only on success

title: A recent language pack deleted then re-picked stays in LanguageBox::removed; a later Restore inserts a duplicate into recent
trigger: Settings > Language: delete recent pack X (removed=[X], dimmed row stays clickable), pick X (install_language -> with_recent puts X back in recent; removed still holds X), pick another pack Y so X is no longer checked, open X's menu: it offers Restore (removed.iter().any) and remove_recent_language(restore=true) inserts X again at recent[index] with no duplicate check
effect: Two rows for the same pack with the same element id, and a duplicate saved in language_recent.json
fix: install_language drops a re-picked pack from LanguageBox::removed (or remove/restore keyed as one list of RecentEntry{choice, Kept|Removed(index)})

title: Dropping a Linux/Windows Locating lookup cancels nothing: cancel() is a no-op and the thread keeps its GeoClue client for up to 20 s
trigger: Open Send Location, then close the picker (or switch account) while 'locating'
effect: The GeoClue client (location indicator in the desktop shell) stays started until the fix or the 20 s timeout; its answer is sent to a dropped Receiver
fix: hold a cancel token (AtomicBool/oneshot) in Locating that the lookup selects on alongside the timer

title: The Instant View reader (Session::messages.instant_view) has no closer in MessageUi's Farewell, so it comes back after switching accounts and back
trigger: Open an Instant View link in account A (the full-window reader overlay shows), switch to account B (replace_screen), switch back to A
effect: A's reader overlay (opaque, inset_0, occludes the chat) is drawn again over the restored screen until the user presses Esc or its close button; sibling session-held boxes (message_report, replies_block) are closed by this very Farewell for the same reason
fix: close it in MessageUi::farewell (session.messages.instant_view = None) or hold the reader in an OnScreen-owned enum

title: chat_preview_overlay draws its loading skeleton from requests.has_purpose_for_chat(GetChatPreview, chat) instead of the chat_preview_fetch Fetch it already reads
trigger: Peek preview of a chat while another window/older request for the same chat is in flight
effect: busy state is read by purpose+chat id, not by the RequestId held in the Fetch (same shape the request-match guard rejects for has_purpose); no wrong output seen because one request per chat

title: send_message_report_text clears the report details field even when report_messages could not be sent
trigger: Report > a reason that needs details > type text > Report while the send is refused (driver Err): the note says 'Could not send the report' and the flow stays on TextRequired
effect: The typed details are gone and must be retyped
fix: clear the field only when the send was accepted (or when the flow leaves TextRequired)

title: ParagraphText keeps click_ranges, actions and link_flags as three parallel Vecs that every push site must extend together
trigger: Any new run kind in paragraph_text (a sixth push site) that pushes a range and an action but forgets link_flags (or the reverse)
effect: None today: all seven push sites extend the three together; the consumer zips them by index, so a miss would shift every later click target and hover underline
